But some use `uv sync --no-cache` without locked (dokumentensuche, kommentar-service, nachforderungen, ner-extraction, dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service, dokumentenschwaerzung-*).

That will fail without uv.lock... unless uv regenerates? `--locked` asserts the lockfile is unchanged and errors if it needs updating. Without lockfile, uv will create it? Actually `uv sync --locked` requires that the `uv.lock` be up to date; if absent it will error. Let me test.
